blueprint.summary: Newsletter platform for sending, subscriber management, segments and growth stats. Subscriber-level history makes it possible to see which signup cohorts unsubscribe.
use_when: You run a newsletter and want cohort-level subscriber analysis
You need segments or growth stats
avoid_when: You need deep cohort analysis inside the dashboard alone: plan an export or API pull

setup.do: Create an API key under Workspace Settings > API; it is shown once and sent as a Bearer token.
Restrict the key to one publication if the workspace has several.

steps.do: Pull subscriber history with signup dates and status.
gotchas: List endpoints page at up to 100 rows

steps.do: Group subscribers by signup period and compare who unsubscribed.
Archive the inactive cohort once the analysis confirms it.
gotchas: Archiving is a live change: get the operator's yes first

pitfalls.issue: Dashboard views stop short of cohort analysis
pitfalls.fix: Export or use the API for anything beyond the built-in stats

pitfalls.issue: Expanded post content may not be cached yet
pitfalls.fix: On HTTP 202, wait for Retry-After and call again

quality_bar: Cohorts compared on the same time window

free_alternatives: The free plan for small lists

limits.note: Per key in fixed 60-second windows, scaling by plan; over it returns HTTP 429

verify_live: Rate limit for the current plan
